g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud landing zone with a Shared VPC host project, service projects and HA VPN

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: An employee's request goes to the data centre's VPN gateway
across HA VPN to the Shared VPC in the host project; Cloud Router exchanges routes over BGP
to the orders internal load balancer in the prod subnet
which spreads requests over VMs in two zones
The VMs query Cloud SQL in the prod service project through a Private Service Connect endpoint
and store documents in Cloud Storage through the Google APIs endpoint, inside the VPC Service Controls perimeter
An organisation log sink sends every project's audit logs to a locked log bucket
Security Command Center publishes new findings to Pub/Sub for the security team
Developers work in Cloud Workstations in the nonprod subnet in another region
against the nonprod project's database, with no route to prod
